after.rosterkit/contacts.py:
# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.models import Student


# ---
def contact_rows(students: Iterable[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Text rows of name, section and email in columns, sorted by name."""
    people = sorted(students, key=lambda student: student.display_name)
    if not people:
        raise ValueError("no students to list")
    for person in people:
        if not person.email:
            raise ValueError(f"no email for {person.display_name}")
    name_width = max(len(person.display_name) for person in people)
    sect_width = max(len(person.section) for person in people)
    return [
        f"{person.display_name:<{name_width}}  {person.section:<{sect_width}}  {person.email}"
        for person in people
    ]
